title: R2d — projects in bootstrap: [projects.<name>] in repo.toml, a projects list per tool, found by detect

keeps.check: Build the worktree engine (go build -o <tmp>/bootstrap ./cmd/bootstrap in cli/) and export BOOTSTRAP_BIN=<tmp>/bootstrap and BOOTSTRAP_CLONE=<worktree>. In a new scratch git repo with pnpm-workspace.yaml (packages: [apps/web]), apps/web/package.json and apps/api/go.mod, run env -u MISE_PROJECT_ROOT BOOTSTRAP_CONFIG=/nonexistent <tmp>/bootstrap init --no-tui --yes --clone <worktree>; then <tmp>/bootstrap detect --add --yes --json --clone <worktree>; then <tmp>/bootstrap describe --json --clone <worktree>.
keeps.pass: describe data.repo has projects api (folder apps/api) and web (folder apps/web); the go tool lists projects [api]; the node tool lists [web]; each tool has a category; a second detect --json proposes no project and no link.

release_levels.reason: Covered by the one bootstrap@4.0.0 tag (R1b D16). New: [projects.<name>] in repo.toml, a projects list per tool in tools.toml, project and per-folder detection, the project checks, and a category per tool in describe.

units.title: The engine: projects, tool links, detect, check, describe
Review: the engine and the tests

shared_files.why: U1 falsifies the config, detect, check and describe docs

decisions.decision: vwf format 28 reads languages and package_manager per project from bootstrap, but no tool has a projects list (ST2 not planned).
decisions.ruling: Bootstrap plan first (Recommended): this plan adds the projects; claude-plugins R4b reads them after the bootstrap 4.0.0 release.
decisions.rejected: Repo-wide for now; keep the keys in format 28.

decisions.decision: What a tool's projects entry names.
decisions.ruling: User: move the project names to bootstrap; vwf uses the bootstrap CLI to get them.
decisions.rejected: Folder paths; free names that bootstrap cannot test.

decisions.decision: Which project fields move into repo.toml.
decisions.ruling: User: name and folder only; platforms are vwf-specific. repo.toml gets [projects.<name>] with folder; each repo lists its own projects.
decisions.rejected: Name only; name, folder and platforms.

decisions.decision: Who fills each tool's projects list.
decisions.ruling: detect, per folder (Recommended): detect runs each detect script in the root and in each [projects.<name>].folder; a match adds that name to the tool's projects; detect --add writes it on consent. check reports a listed project whose folder no longer matches.
decisions.rejected: vwf writes it; by hand only.

decisions.decision: Who writes the [projects.<name>] tables.
decisions.ruling: User: either. bootstrap detects the existing ones; vwf creates new ones through the bootstrap CLI (config set).

decisions.decision: How bootstrap detects an existing project.
decisions.ruling: Both: the workspace manifests first; then the language-tool match for the folders they do not name.
decisions.rejected: Language-tool match only; workspace manifests only.

decisions.decision: Stated by the planner, confirmed at the shape gate: the schema.
decisions.ruling: [projects.<name>].folder is repo-relative; . is the root. A name is lowercase kebab case. [tools.<t>].projects = [<name>...] is always valid, as env is (R1a D86); each name must be a [projects.<name>] of the same repo.toml, else code 2. A root_only tool has no projects (code 2).

decisions.decision: Stated by the planner, confirmed at the shape gate: the project detection.
decisions.ruling: Workspace manifests: pnpm-workspace.yaml (packages), go.work (use), Cargo.toml [workspace] members, pyproject.toml [tool.uv.workspace] members, globs expanded. Then the folder walk skips .git, node_modules, vendor and the gitignored paths; a folder inside a found project is not a new project. With no project found, the root is one project named repo_name. A name is the folder basename; when two are the same, the path with / replaced by -. A listed project is never proposed again.

decisions.decision: Stated by the planner, confirmed at the shape gate: detect output and writes.
decisions.ruling: detect --json data adds projects (the new [projects.<name>] tables) and links (tool to the project names to add). detect --add writes both on consent (--yes or the prompt). A tool that matches only in a project folder is offered too. init and the TUI write no projects.

decisions.decision: Stated by the planner, confirmed at the shape gate: check.
decisions.ruling: A listed project whose folder does not exist is a finding with code 2. A tool link whose detect script no longer gives match in that folder is a warning.

decisions.decision: Stated by the planner, confirmed at the shape gate: describe.
decisions.ruling: Each tool in describe data.tools gets category, from the catalog. Additive: the contract stays 1 (R1b D7). The projects come through data.repo and each tool's values.

decisions.decision: Stated by the planner, confirmed at the shape gate: config.
decisions.ruling: config set repo.projects.<name> '<JSON table>' --json works through the R1a schema table. config unset repo.projects.<name> stops with code 2 while a tool lists the name, and the error names those tools.

decisions.decision: Stated by the planner, confirmed at the shape gate: release and docs.
decisions.ruling: No new level: the one bootstrap@4.0.0 tag covers it (R1b D16). U4 updates docs/design/, README.md, CLAUDE.md and the ST2 line of the decision record.

decisions.decision: Round 1 gap 1: a package manager matches only at the root, so it never links to a project.
decisions.ruling: A tool that matches at the root and in no project folder links to the projects that the workspace manifest in its evidence names (pnpm: the packages of pnpm-workspace.yaml). With no workspace manifest in its evidence, it links to the root project.
decisions.rejected: Link to every project; link to none.

decisions.decision: Round 1 gap 2: a monorepo root with its own manifest matches in the walk.
decisions.ruling: The walk skips the root when step 1 or the walk below the root found a project. The root is a project only when nothing else is found (D8 step 3).

decisions.decision: Round 1 gap 3: a basename or repo_name that is not kebab case.
decisions.ruling: Normalize to lowercase kebab case (My_App → my-app). An empty result skips the folder with a warning.

decisions.decision: Round 1 gap 4: is a listed project matched by name or by folder?
decisions.ruling: By folder: a listed folder is never proposed again. A new folder whose name is already used takes the path form of D8 step 4.

decisions.decision: Round 1 gap 5: the walk has no depth limit.
decisions.ruling: The walk stops 4 levels below the root, as hasFile does (cli/internal/repo/rules.go:401).

decisions.decision: Round 1 gap 6: on the first detect, do the per-folder runs cover the proposed projects?
decisions.ruling: Yes: the runs cover the listed projects and the projects proposed in the same run; --add writes both together.

decisions.decision: Round 1 gap 7: 24 detect scripts in repo/tools/*/scripts/detect say bootstrap detect runs them in the root.
decisions.ruling: U4 owns repo/tools/*/scripts/detect for that comment line only; the new text says: in the root, and in each project folder.

decisions.decision: Round 1 gap 8: a deleted project folder also gives no-match link warnings.
decisions.ruling: Report only the code 2 finding for the missing folder; no link warning for that project.

decisions.decision: Round 2 gap 1: a D14 link never gives match when its detect script runs in the project folder, so check warns on every run.
decisions.ruling: check tests a D14 link the way detect made it: the tool still matches at the root, and the workspace manifest in its evidence still names the folder. It does not run the script in the project folder.

decisions.decision: Round 2 gap 2: D14 links to the root project, which does not exist in a monorepo (D15).
decisions.ruling: With no root project, a D14 tool with no workspace manifest in its evidence gets no link.

decisions.decision: Round 2 gap 3: aube's evidence aube-workspace.yaml is not a D8 step 1 manifest.
decisions.ruling: D8 step 1 and D14 also read aube-workspace.yaml (packages).

decisions.decision: Round 2 gap 4: D14 links repo-wide tools (git, github, gitleaks, dprint, mise) to the root project.
decisions.ruling: The D14 root fallback links only tools of the categories languages and package-managers. A tool that matches in a project folder links by D4, whatever its category.

decisions.decision: Round 3 gap 1: docker is root_only, but its detect script matches in a project folder; D4 links it and D7 makes the link code 2.
decisions.ruling: detect never links a root_only tool, and check skips it.

decisions.decision: Round 3 gap 2: the android, apko, docker, java, kotlin and melange scripts search with find -maxdepth, so the walk matches in a parent folder.
decisions.ruling: A match in the walk or in a project folder counts only when one of its evidence paths sits in that folder itself (the path has no /).

decisions.decision: Round 3 gap 3: a workspace manifest can name the root itself.
decisions.ruling: A step 1 member equal to . is dropped; the root is a project only by D8 step 3.

decisions.decision: Round 3 gap 4: the manifests also exclude folders, and a member can name a missing folder or a file.
decisions.ruling: Apply the pnpm and aube ! patterns and the Cargo and uv exclude lists; keep only folders that exist; apply the D8 nesting and gitignore rules to the step 1 folders too.

decisions.decision: Round 4 gap 1: a root project's folder is ., so repo-wide tools link by D4 and undo D25.
decisions.ruling: A project with folder . gets D4 links only from tools of the categories languages and package-managers.

decisions.decision: Round 4 gap 2: tools.toml stores only names, so check cannot tell a D14 link from a D4 link.
decisions.ruling: A link passes when either test holds: the script matches in the folder (with D27), or the D22 root-and-manifest test (D22 only for languages and package-managers tools). check warns only when both fail.

decisions.decision: G1: gate line `mise x -- mise run code:lint` is red at preflight — code:lint:60-bootstrap runs the released bootstrap 3.3.1 against the shared cache clone, whose catalog 3.3.1 cannot read. How should the run make this line pass?
decisions.ruling: User (relayed by the all loop, the same ruling as D38/Q8 of docs/plans/archived/2026-11-14-plugins-setup-ai): point the line at the catalog the released engine can read — run it with the released 3.3.1 and BOOTSTRAP_CACHE set to a scratch clone at 1f7b0a2; the line then checks this repo old-form values as before, and test:repo and test:go still cover the plan own catalog changes. Apply it to code:lint:60-bootstrap at the preflight, at every gate point of this run and in the pre-commit hooks; every other gate line runs as written. Standing rule: every gate and the pre-commit hooks green before the landing; any other red line: do not land, report it.
decisions.rejected: Stop the run at the preflight

decisions.decision: Q1: When a plain `bootstrap detect` (no --add) finds projects or links to write but no tool to add, what should its exit code be?
decisions.ruling: Keep 0 (implemented) — projects and links print under "Projects, not written" with an info line "run bootstrap detect --add to write the projects"; the exit code depends only on tools, so existing scripts and test:repo detect cases that expect 0 keep working
decisions.rejected: Exit 1, as for an offered tool

decisions.decision: Q2: When detect reads a workspace manifest, should a member folder that exists but holds no package file of that workspace still be proposed as a project?
decisions.ruling: Keep the marker-file rule (implemented) and record it as a decision — a folder like apps/docs with no package file is not proposed, as pnpm itself skips it
decisions.rejected: Drop the rule and keep every existing folder, per D29 as written

decisions.decision: Q3: During bootstrap check, when a linked tool's detect script fails or prints no valid result in a project folder, should that be a code 2 finding or a link warning?
decisions.ruling: Code 2 (implemented) — matches detect, where a script failure is code 2
decisions.rejected: A warning, as for a link with no match
